_harness.iterations: how many modules to run before exiting — 0 = loop forever
_harness.no_repeat_window: never repeat any of the last N modules (1 = just no back-to-back repeats)
_harness.recency_boost: above 0 favors modules that haven't run in a while; 0 = pure weights
_harness.track_history: append every run to the history file (for stats)

_module_common.after: predecessor → multiplier map, e.g. {"fireworks": 4.0} = 4x more likely right after fireworks
_module_common.enabled: include this module in the random rotation
_module_common.weight: selection weight — 2.0 comes up twice as often as 1.0 (default 1.0)

ant_colony.alpha: pheromone influence exponent in ant choice p ~ tau^alpha * eta^beta
ant_colony.beta: distance-heuristic influence exponent in ant choice (higher = greedier)
ant_colony.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
ant_colony.evaporation: fraction of pheromone lost per iteration, clamped to 0..0.99 (rho)
ant_colony.frame_delay: seconds between frames via input timeout (lower = faster animation)
ant_colony.num_ants: ants building tours each ACO iteration (min 2)
ant_colony.num_cities: number of random TSP cities scattered on screen (min 4)

bifurcation.cols_per_frame: terminal columns computed and drawn per frame (min 1, higher = faster sweep)
bifurcation.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
bifurcation.r_max: right edge of the r range, clamped to <= 4.0
bifurcation.r_min: left edge of the logistic-map r range, clamped to >= 0 (reset to 2.8 if r_max <= r_min)
bifurcation.samples: attractor samples histogrammed per column (min 24, higher = denser detail)

bluetooth_scan.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
bluetooth_scan.frame_delay: seconds between animation frames (sweep, RSSI jitter)
bluetooth_scan.simulate: true = always use fake devices; false = try system_profiler/bluetoothctl first (accepts truthy strings)

boids.align_w: weight of the alignment force (match neighbors' velocity)
boids.coh_w: weight of the cohesion force (steer toward neighbors' center)
boids.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
boids.max_speed: speed cap in cells/sec; velocities are rescaled to this limit
boids.neigh_dist: distance (cells) within which boids count as neighbors for align/cohere
boids.num_boids: number of boids in the flock (min 2)
boids.sep_dist: distance (cells) under which boids push apart
boids.sep_w: weight of the separation force (avoid crowding)

bouncing_balls.damping: velocity multiplier on each wall bounce (<1 loses energy, 1 = perfectly elastic)
bouncing_balls.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
bouncing_balls.gravity: downward acceleration in cells/sec^2 added to vy each frame
bouncing_balls.trail_length: positions kept per ball for the fading trail (0 = no trail)

bouncing_mesh.angular_speed: tumble rate in radians/sec around the spin axis
bouncing_mesh.bounce_jitter: random perturbation added to the spin axis on each wall bounce (0 = fixed axis)
bouncing_mesh.box_x: half-width of the bounce box in world x (grown to fit the mesh if too small)
bouncing_mesh.box_y: half-height of the bounce box in world y (grown to fit the mesh if too small)
bouncing_mesh.box_z_max: far z wall of the bounce box (depth of travel)
bouncing_mesh.box_z_min: near z wall of the bounce box (camera at z=0 looking down +z)
bouncing_mesh.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
bouncing_mesh.focal_factor: focal length as a fraction of terminal height (higher = more zoomed/telephoto)
bouncing_mesh.linear_speed: translation speed in world units/sec along a random direction
bouncing_mesh.mesh_file: .obj path (or directory to pick a random .obj), relative to repo root; falls back to a cube
bouncing_mesh.mesh_scale: bounding-sphere radius after the mesh is normalized to unit size

cellular_automaton.completion_pause: seconds to keep the final frame on screen after duration ends
cellular_automaton.density: probability 0..1 that each cell starts alive when (re)seeding
cellular_automaton.duration: seconds to run before exiting (None = run forever)
cellular_automaton.step_delay: seconds between Game of Life generations

chaos_game.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
chaos_game.points_per_frame: IFS points iterated and deposited per frame (min 1, higher = faster fill)
chaos_game.switch_time: seconds spent on each attractor before clearing and switching to the next

chladni.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
chladni.hold_time: seconds to hold a finished pattern before morphing to the next
chladni.max_mode: upper bound for random plate mode numbers m,n (min 2; higher = finer patterns)
chladni.morph_time: seconds to crossfade between two mode patterns (min 0.1)

clock.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
clock.frame_delay: seconds between frames (lower = smoother second hand and sparks)
clock.scale: block size of each big-digit pixel in cells (min 1; auto-shrinks to fit)

connections.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
connections.frame_delay: seconds between frames (arc pulse animation speed)
connections.refresh_interval: seconds between re-polling lsof/netstat (or the simulator) for connections
connections.simulate: true = always synthesize fake connections; false = read real ones, falling back to fake if none (accepts truthy strings)

cyclic_ca.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
cyclic_ca.frame_delay: seconds between CA steps (lower = faster animation)
cyclic_ca.moore: true = 8-neighbor Moore neighborhood, false = 4-neighbor von Neumann (accepts truthy strings)
cyclic_ca.num_states: cyclic states per cell (min 3); replaced by a random 8-16 on auto-reseed
cyclic_ca.threshold: neighbors already in the successor state needed for a cell to advance (min 1)

decryption.completion_pause: seconds the ACCESS GRANTED banner stays up before new targets are generated
decryption.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
decryption.frame_delay: seconds between frames (glyph churn and lock speed)
decryption.key_length: characters in the AES key/hash targets (min 4); passphrase length is derived from it

directory_structure_visualizer.duration: seconds to keep the finished tree on screen after the reveal animation ends (None = stay until q/ESC)
directory_structure_visualizer.expand_interval: seconds between directory-expansion reveal steps of the animation
directory_structure_visualizer.reverse: true = flip the tree so the root is at the bottom and branches grow upward
directory_structure_visualizer.target_path: directory to render as a tree (None = current working directory); exits if not a directory

dla.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
dla.kill_buffer: cells beyond the bounding box where a wandering walker is killed (forced > spawn_buffer)
dla.max_walker_steps: random-walk steps before a walker is abandoned (min 100)
dla.particles_per_color: particles placed before the color cycles to the next palette entry (min 1)
dla.seed_count: number of scattered seed points when seed_mode="random" (min 1; unused otherwise)
dla.seed_mode: initial cluster shape: "center" (single point), "bottom" (full bottom row), or "random" (scattered points)
dla.spawn_buffer: cells beyond the cluster bounding box where walkers spawn (min 1; smaller = faster sticking)
dla.walkers_per_frame: random walkers launched per frame (min 1, higher = faster growth)

dna_helix.bp_per_turn: base pairs per full 360-degree twist (min 1; 10 = B-DNA-like)
dna_helix.duration: seconds to run before exiting the visualization loop
dna_helix.helix_height: accepted and validated (min 2) but never used by the render loop
dna_helix.num_pairs: base pairs in the random sequence, one column each (min 2)
dna_helix.radius: strand distance from the center axis in rows (helix visual thickness)

double_pendulum.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
double_pendulum.g: gravitational acceleration used by the integrator
double_pendulum.l1: length of the upper arm in world units
double_pendulum.l2: length of the lower arm in world units
double_pendulum.m1: mass of the upper bob in the pendulum equations
double_pendulum.m2: mass of the lower bob in the pendulum equations
double_pendulum.scale: world-to-screen zoom; cells per world unit (x doubled for char aspect)
double_pendulum.sub_steps: RK4 integration sub-steps per frame (higher = more stable, min 1)
double_pendulum.trail_length: max points kept in the end-bob trail (0 = no trail)

falling_sand.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
falling_sand.fill_limit: movable-cell fraction of the grid (0.05-0.95) that triggers the dissolve phase
falling_sand.spawn_rate: cells each emitter drops per frame (fire emits half this, min 1)

fire.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
fire.intensity: max random heat decay per cell as flames rise (higher = shorter, choppier flames)
fire.spark_rate: spark spawn attempts per frame, each with 50% chance (0 = no sparks)

fireworks.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
fireworks.fall_speed: (min, max) initial speed range for fall-burst particles (None = (45, 60))
fireworks.gravity: downward acceleration on particles in cells/sec^2
fireworks.launch_rate: average rocket launches per second (probability launch_rate*dt each frame)
fireworks.multi_count: seed particles per 'multi' burst that re-explode later
fireworks.multi_fade_duration: seconds secondary sparks stochastically fade from seed color to final color
fireworks.multi_secondary_count: sparks each multi seed emits when it re-explodes
fireworks.multi_secondary_speed: (min, max) speed range for secondary sparks after seeds re-explode (None = (70, 90))
fireworks.multi_speed: (min, max) initial speed range for multi-burst seeds (None = (30, 42))
fireworks.ring_count: evenly spaced particles per expanding 'ring' burst
fireworks.ring_speed: (min, max) range the ring's single expansion speed is drawn from (None = (50, 65))
fireworks.simple_speed: (min, max) initial speed range for simple-burst particles (None = (45, 65))
fireworks.willow_speed: (min, max) initial speed range for willow-burst particles (None = (25, 35))

fourier_epicycles.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
fourier_epicycles.num_terms: number of Fourier terms / chained circles in the epicycle stack (min 1)
fourier_epicycles.omega: base angular speed in radians/sec; each harmonic spins at freq*omega
fourier_epicycles.scale: cells per amplitude unit (auto-shrunk if the chain would leave the screen)
fourier_epicycles.total_amplitude: sum of |amplitudes| the terms are normalized to; sets the chain's overall size
fourier_epicycles.wave_history: number of tip samples kept in the scrolling wave plot (min 2)
fourier_epicycles.wave_type: waveform to synthesize: square, sawtooth, triangle, pulse, or random = pick one

galton_board.ball_rate: spawn interval in frames: one new ball every ball_rate frames (min 1)
galton_board.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
galton_board.fall_speed: ball fall speed in terminal cells per second
galton_board.rows: peg rows in the pyramid, giving rows+1 bins (min 2, capped to fit screen)

grapher.duration: seconds to hold the finished chart after animating (0 = no hold, exit immediately)
grapher.step_delay: seconds paused after each point added while a series animates in

gray_scott.color_choice: palette index 1-6 for the field color, or random = pick one
gray_scott.dt: forward-Euler timestep per simulation step (larger = faster but less stable)
gray_scott.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
gray_scott.preset: F/k parameter preset: spots, stripes, mazes, fingers, worms, ripples, or random = pick one
gray_scott.sub_steps: simulation steps computed per rendered frame (higher = faster evolution, min 1)

hypercube.angular_speeds: list of up to 6 rotation speeds in rad/sec for planes xy,xz,xw,yz,yw,zw (0 = plane off, None = default mix)
hypercube.distance: how far the projected object sits in front of the 3D camera along z
hypercube.distance_4d: 4D camera distance along w for the 4D-to-3D perspective divide (smaller = stronger inner/outer cube contrast)
hypercube.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
hypercube.focal_factor: pinhole focal length as a fraction of terminal height (larger = bigger on screen)
hypercube.mesh_scale: uniform scale applied to the 3D vertices after 4D projection

ising_model.J: spin coupling constant; scales the Metropolis energy change 2*J*s*neighbors
ising_model.T_max: high end of the sinusoidal temperature sweep
ising_model.T_min: low end of the sinusoidal temperature sweep
ising_model.T_period: seconds for one full temperature oscillation across the critical point
ising_model.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
ising_model.sweeps_per_frame: full Monte Carlo sweeps (rows*cols flip attempts each) per frame (min 1)

julia_set.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
julia_set.max_iter: escape-time iteration cap per pixel (higher = more detail, slower frames)
julia_set.morph_radius: radius of the circular path c traces around the chosen base constant
julia_set.morph_speed: angular speed in radians/sec of c's circular morph path

knights_tour.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished board before exiting
knights_tour.n: board size: n x n squares for the knight to visit
knights_tour.target_size: desired board width in terminal cells used to size the squares (clamped to fit)

langtons_ant.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
langtons_ant.num_ants: number of ants stepping round-robin on the shared grid (min 1)
langtons_ant.rule: turn rule string of L/R per cell state (e.g. LR, LLRR); random = generate one
langtons_ant.steps_per_frame: total ant steps simulated per frame, spread across the ants (min 1)

letter_frequency.completion_pause: seconds to hold the final chart after the words run out
letter_frequency.duration: seconds before exiting early (None = no time limit, run through all words)
letter_frequency.num_words: number of words to take from the file (<= 0 = use all)
letter_frequency.text_file: path to the word list, relative to the project root (one word per line)
letter_frequency.word_delay: seconds paused between processing each word

lorenz_attractor.beta: Lorenz beta parameter in the ODEs
lorenz_attractor.duration: seconds to run before exiting back to the harness
lorenz_attractor.rho: Lorenz rho parameter (Rayleigh number) in the ODEs
lorenz_attractor.scale: cells per attractor unit (x doubled for char aspect)
lorenz_attractor.sigma: Lorenz sigma parameter (Prandtl number) in the ODEs
lorenz_attractor.sub_dt: ODE timestep for each RK4 sub-step (smaller = more accurate)
lorenz_attractor.sub_steps: RK4 integration steps per frame (higher = faster trace, min 1)
lorenz_attractor.trail_length: max points kept in the fading trail (0 = head only)
lorenz_attractor.view_rotation_speed: radians/sec the view spins around the z axis for a 3D feel

lsystem.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished curve before exiting
lsystem.duration: seconds to run before exiting (hard cap even if still drawing)
lsystem.preset: curve preset: fractal_tree, koch, koch_snowflake, sierpinski, dragon, plant, sierpinski_arrowhead, or random = pick one
lsystem.segments_per_frame: line segments appended to the canvas each frame (min 1)

mandelbrot.base_iter: starting escape-iteration count; grows by ~60 per decade of zoom
mandelbrot.duration: seconds to run before exiting the zoom loop
mandelbrot.zoom_factor: zoom multiplier applied each frame (higher = faster dive, resets past 1e13)

matrix_breach.duration: seconds to run the whole hack sequence before exiting
matrix_breach.phase_time: seconds spent in each phase (RECON/EXPLOIT/ACCESS/EXFIL); <=0 coerced to 1.0
matrix_breach.rain_density: 0-1 spawn chance scale for background rain columns (clamped, x0.08 per column per frame)

matrix_rain.density: per-column chance each frame of spawning a new drop (0-1, higher = denser rain)
matrix_rain.duration: seconds the rain runs before exiting
matrix_rain.loading_duration: seconds for the fake loading bar shown first; 0 = skip it
matrix_rain.speed: frames/sec of the rain animation (frame delay = 1/speed)

maze_generator.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished maze on screen before exiting
maze_generator.step_delay: seconds paused after each carving step (lower = faster generation)

metaballs.num_blobs: number of drifting metaballs in the field (min 1)
metaballs.threshold: field iso-value defining the blob surface (lower = fatter blobs; contour band drawn at +/-12%)

metaprogramming_imports.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished chart on screen after all files are scanned
metaprogramming_imports.duration: max seconds to run overall; None = no time limit, scan every file
metaprogramming_imports.file_delay: seconds paused after scanning each python file (lower = faster chart updates)

n_body.G: gravitational constant used in the force law
n_body.duration: seconds to run the simulation before exiting
n_body.num_planets: number of planets orbiting the sun (min 1)
n_body.planet_mass_max: upper bound of uniform random planet mass
n_body.planet_mass_min: lower bound of uniform random planet mass
n_body.radius_jitter: world units of random offset added to each planet's base orbital radius
n_body.softening: distance-squared softening added to avoid singular close encounters
n_body.sub_steps: physics integration sub-steps per frame for stability (min 1)
n_body.sun_mass: mass of the central sun (sets orbital speeds)
n_body.tangent_jitter: radians of random tilt from purely tangential launch direction
n_body.trail_length: max trail points kept per body (0 = no trails)
n_body.velocity_jitter: fractional random offset around circular orbit speed (0.3 = +/-30%; makes eccentric orbits)
n_body.view_scale: screen chars per world unit (higher = zoomed in; x doubled for aspect)

n_queens.completion_pause: seconds to hold the solved board on screen before exiting
n_queens.n: board size and queen count (N x N board)
n_queens.step_delay: seconds paused after each placement/backtrack step (lower = faster solve)
n_queens.target_size: desired board width in characters; cells sized to fit this and the terminal

netmap.frame_delay: seconds between frames (lower = faster pulse animation)
netmap.refresh_interval: seconds between arp rescans that diff joins/leaves
netmap.simulate: true = always show fake LAN devices; false = use real arp/ip-neigh, faking only on failure

nmap_replay.duration: seconds to run before exiting (engagements restart until then)
nmap_replay.num_hosts: fake hosts discovered per engagement (min 1, capped at 254)
nmap_replay.scan_speed: multiplier on the ~12 lines/sec output pace (min 0.1; higher = faster scroll)

packet_sniffer.max_pps: synthesized packet lines emitted per second (capped at 12 per frame)
packet_sniffer.poll_interval: seconds between lsof/netstat polls for real connection churn
packet_sniffer.simulate: true = skip real lsof/netstat and fabricate all connections

pathfinding.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished path on screen before exiting
pathfinding.step_delay: seconds paused after each A* expansion and each path cell drawn (lower = faster)

pendulum_wave.T_beat: seconds until all pendulums realign (pendulum i does period_offset+i cycles in this time)
pendulum_wave.amplitude_deg: swing amplitude in degrees from vertical
pendulum_wave.num_pendulums: number of pendulums across the screen (min 2)
pendulum_wave.period_offset: cycles the slowest pendulum completes per T_beat (min 1; higher = faster, closer periods)

percolation.completion_pause: seconds the spanning-cluster flash holds before resetting with a fresh grid
percolation.p_end: occupation probability the sweep ramps up to (capped there)
percolation.p_start: occupation probability at the start of each sweep
percolation.sweep_time: seconds to ramp p from p_start to p_end

plasma.duration: seconds of plasma to play at 20 fps; None = ~500 frames (~25s)
plasma.loading_duration: seconds for the fake loading bar shown first

port_scanner.completion_pause: seconds to hold each sweep's summary on screen before the next sweep
port_scanner.connect_timeout: seconds per TCP connect attempt before a port counts as filtered
port_scanner.duration: seconds to run before exiting (sweeps rotate target/gateway until then)
port_scanner.target: host to scan; only localhost/private IPs allowed, anything else falls back to 127.0.0.1
port_scanner.workers: thread pool size and probes launched per frame (min 1)

predator_prey.alpha: prey growth rate in the Lotka-Volterra equations
predator_prey.beta: predation rate: prey lost per prey-predator encounter
predator_prey.history_size: points kept in the plots (min 2); older points scroll off
predator_prey.sim_speed: simulation time multiplier per wall-clock second (higher = faster cycles)

prime_sieve.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished sieve before exiting
prime_sieve.n: sieve upper bound: marks numbers 2..n as prime or composite
prime_sieve.step_delay: seconds paused after each composite is marked (lower = faster)

progress_bars.completion_pause: seconds to hold the completed screen before exiting
progress_bars.duration: seconds until the overall bar hits 100% and the run ends
progress_bars.num_bars: number of fake process bars shown (each finishes at 15-95% of duration)

rainbow_code.cycle_length: characters per full rainbow cycle (smaller = faster color change)
rainbow_code.duration: seconds to run; typing speed is set so the whole file fits this window

raymarch_sdf.hold_time: seconds each shape is held before the next morph starts (min 0)
raymarch_sdf.march_steps: max raymarch iterations per ray (min 8; more = crisper edges, slower)
raymarch_sdf.morph_time: seconds to blend from one shape to the next (min 0.1)

rss_feed_reader.completion_pause: seconds to hold the final chart (or the error screen) before exiting
rss_feed_reader.duration: max seconds to run including the final hold; None = process all entries
rss_feed_reader.entry_delay: seconds paused after each entry is added to the word counts
rss_feed_reader.feeds: list of RSS feed URLs to fetch; None = NYT/BBC/CNN defaults

sandpile.grains_per_frame: sand grains dropped per frame, split across drop sites (min 1)
sandpile.topple_iters_per_frame: max toppling passes per frame; big avalanches span extra frames (min 1)

shaded_mesh.ambient: base light level 0-1 added before diffuse shading (higher = fewer dark faces)
shaded_mesh.angular_speed: rotation rate in radians/sec about a random axis
shaded_mesh.distance: camera-to-mesh distance along z (larger = smaller on screen)
shaded_mesh.focal_factor: focal length as a fraction of terminal height (larger = more zoomed in)
shaded_mesh.light_offset: [x, y, z] position of the point light; None = [3.0, 2.0, 0.0]
shaded_mesh.mesh_file: .obj file or directory (relative to repo root); a directory picks a random .obj, failures fall back to a cube
shaded_mesh.mesh_scale: size multiplier applied after the mesh is normalized to a unit sphere

sir_epidemic.beta: infection probability per infected neighbor per step
sir_epidemic.duration: seconds to run before exiting (ends early if infections die out)
sir_epidemic.gamma: recovery probability per infected cell per step
sir_epidemic.grid_fraction: fraction of screen height for the agent grid vs the curves (clamped 0.3-0.85)
sir_epidemic.history_size: time steps kept in the S/I/R curves (min 2); older points scroll off

slime_mold.decay: trail retained after each blur pass, 0-1 (lower = faster evaporation)
slime_mold.deposit: trail intensity each agent lays down per step
slime_mold.num_agents: number of Physarum agents (min 50; scaled down on small terminals)
slime_mold.sensor_angle: radians the left/right sensors are offset from each agent's heading
slime_mold.sensor_dist: cells ahead the sensors sample the trail
slime_mold.turn_speed: radians turned per step toward the strongest sensor

snake_ai.duration: seconds to run before exiting (games restart automatically)
snake_ai.frame_delay: seconds per tick when the snake is short (min 0.005)
snake_ai.min_delay: seconds per tick the game speeds up to as the snake grows (min 0.005, capped at frame_delay)

solar_orrery.show_labels: draw each planet's name next to it
solar_orrery.show_outer: include Jupiter-Neptune; False = inner four planets only
solar_orrery.time_jitter: radial wobble amplitude as a fraction of orbit radius (0 = perfect circles)

sorting_visualizer.completion_pause: seconds to hold the fully sorted array before exiting
sorting_visualizer.step_delay: seconds paused after each compare/swap (lower = faster sort)

space_filling.duration: seconds to run before exiting; stages cycle until then
space_filling.pause_time: seconds to hold a finished curve before deepening to the next stage (min 0)
space_filling.segments_per_frame: curve segments revealed per frame (min 1; higher = faster tracing)

spirograph.hold_time: seconds to hold a completed curve before starting a new one
spirograph.speed: pen parameter advance in radians per second (higher = faster tracing)
spirograph.trail_len: max points kept in the fading trail (min 10)

starfield.num_stars: number of stars flying toward the viewer
starfield.speed: depth units each star moves toward the camera per frame

stock_crypto_ticker.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
stock_crypto_ticker.frame_delay: seconds between frames; prices tick every 0.5s regardless
stock_crypto_ticker.refresh_interval: seconds between live API fetches (min 5; only used when simulate=false)
stock_crypto_ticker.simulate: true = random-walk prices offline; false = fetch live CoinGecko/Yahoo prices
stock_crypto_ticker.symbols: comma-separated symbols to keep from the default universe; None = all 13

strange_attractors.batch: number of points iterated and splatted per frame (min 10; more = denser image)
strange_attractors.drift: amplitude of the sinusoidal wobble added to attractor parameters (0 = static shape)
strange_attractors.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
strange_attractors.iters_per_frame: attractor map iterations applied to every point each frame (min 1)
strange_attractors.switch_time: seconds spent on each attractor before cycling to the next (min 1)

sudoku.completion_pause: seconds to hold the solved board before exiting
sudoku.duration: seconds over which the recorded solve trace is replayed
sudoku.log_lines: rows of recent place/undo events shown in the activity panel (min 1)
sudoku.target_size: target board width in characters; cell size derived from it, clamped to screen

terrain_flyover.camera_height: baseline camera altitude the bobbing motion centers on (kept 5 above terrain)
terrain_flyover.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
terrain_flyover.height_scale: vertical exaggeration multiplier applied to the 0..1 heightmap
terrain_flyover.speed: forward flight speed in heightmap units per second
terrain_flyover.view_distance: number of depth slices rendered toward the horizon (min 8; more = farther view, slower)

tower_of_hanoi.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished towers before exiting
tower_of_hanoi.history_lines: rows of recent moves shown in the history list (min 1)
tower_of_hanoi.num_disks: number of disks on the starting peg (total moves = 2^n - 1)
tower_of_hanoi.step_delay: seconds paused after each disk move

tunnel.depth_scale: band depth divisor; larger = wider, more stretched rings
tunnel.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
tunnel.speed: how fast the tunnel bands rush toward the viewer (depth units per second)

turing_machine.completion_pause: seconds the HALTED/MAX STEPS banner flashes before the next machine
turing_machine.duration: seconds to run, cycling through the busy-beaver machines
turing_machine.step_delay: starting seconds per machine step; decays 5%/step toward a 0.01s floor

ulam_spiral.completion_pause: seconds to hold the finished spiral before exiting
ulam_spiral.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
ulam_spiral.max_n: largest integer walked in the spiral, sieved for primality (min 2)
ulam_spiral.numbers_per_frame: integers plotted per frame (min 1; higher = faster spiral growth)

unredact.completion_pause: seconds to hold the fully revealed document before exiting
unredact.duration: seconds over which all redacted words are progressively revealed
unredact.num_paragraphs: contiguous paragraphs sampled from the text (min 3 enforced)
unredact.redact_probability: chance (0..1) each word starts as a redacted #### block
unredact.text_file: path to source text (relative to repo root); split on blank lines into paragraphs

wave.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
wave.mode: which pattern to draw: sine, lissajous, standing, beats, packet, rose, spirograph, damped, ekg; 'random' picks one
wave.num_waves: number of overlaid sine curves (min 1; only used by the 'sine' mode)

wave_on_string.amplitude: displacement value mapped to the full screen half-height; larger values clamp
wave_on_string.c2: wave speed coefficient c^2 in the discrete wave equation (keep <= 1 for stability)
wave_on_string.damping: per-step energy loss fraction (0 = undamped, waves never decay)
wave_on_string.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
wave_on_string.pulse_interval: seconds between random gaussian pulses injected into the string
wave_on_string.pulse_strength: peak displacement of each injected gaussian pulse
wave_on_string.steps_per_frame: physics steps computed per drawn frame (min 1; higher = faster wave motion)

wifi_scan.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
wifi_scan.frame_delay: seconds between frames; each frame jitters signal bars slightly
wifi_scan.refresh_interval: seconds between re-scans of the network list (nmcli/system_profiler or new fake set)
wifi_scan.simulate: true = always show fake networks; false = try nmcli (Linux) / current net (macOS) first

window_spawner.child_duration: seconds each module runs inside a child window
window_spawner.duration: seconds budget; only bounds the no-backend error screen (min(4, duration))
window_spawner.max_wait: seconds to wait for children before giving up; 0 = auto from runs and child_duration
window_spawner.num_windows: terminal windows/panes to spawn, each running its own module set (min 1)
window_spawner.pool: comma-separated module names children may run; None = built-in default pool
window_spawner.runs_per_window: scheduler iterations each child window runs before exiting (min 1)
window_spawner.subset_size: modules randomly picked from the pool for each window (min 1)

wireworld.duration: seconds to run, cycling circuits every 10s
wireworld.generations_per_frame: Wireworld generations computed per drawn frame (min 1)

wolfram_rule.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
wolfram_rule.frame_delay: seconds between generations (one new row per frame)
wolfram_rule.rule: Wolfram rule number 0-255; 'random' picks from a curated interesting set
wolfram_rule.seed_mode: initial row: 'single' = one center cell, 'random' = random bits (else single)

worldmap_attack.duration: seconds to run before the harness picks the next module
worldmap_attack.max_active: cap on simultaneously drawn attack arcs (min 1)
worldmap_attack.spawn_rate: new attack arcs launched per second (accumulated fractionally)
